products.name: tl;dv
products.note: Meeting recorder AI; timestamped notes; EU-hosted; GDPR; consent management

profile_text.body:
tl;dv is a software company whose product, also called tl;dv (short for "Too Long, Didn't View"), is an AI-powered meeting recorder and notetaker that works with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The service automatically records, transcribes, and summarizes calls, then logs notes and CRM outcomes, drafts follow-up emails, and generates reports delivered to users' inboxes. The site describes support for over 30 languages and dialects and integration with CRMs, ticketing systems, knowledge management platforms, and over 5,000 other tools.

The company describes tl;dv as going beyond simple note-taking, positioning it as a sales coaching platform that allows sales managers to track playbook adherence, monitor objection handling, and review representative performance. New hires can review AI-selected clips from past customer calls, and aggregated insights can surface trends across multiple meetings. The site also notes that a Free Forever plan is available and contrasts this with what it characterizes as a $5,000 or more upfront investment required by Gong.

On data handling, the site states that recordings and transcripts are not used to train AI, that the company partners with Anthropic for generative AI processing, and that meetings are anonymized and processed in randomized small chunks. Data is described as stored in ISO 27001-certified centers with AES-256 encryption, and the product is noted as GDPR-compliant and SOC 2-certified. The held facts confirm the product is EU-hosted with consent management features, and no litigation or other filings are on record for the company.
